tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Find any instrument OwlChart covers: crypto coins and perpetuals, stocks, ETFs, forex, indices, futures, commodities, bonds and economic series. Returns ids like crypto_perp:bybit:BTCUSDT or equity:NASDAQ:AAPL to use in get_price_history.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: OHLCV candles for any market with a short summary (last price, change over the window, high, low). Accepts a plain ticker (BTC, ETH, AAPL) or an id from search_markets.

tools.name: get_liquidity_heatmap
tools.description: OwlChart consensus direction for a coin (one answer shared by every OwlChart chart: lead with consensus.headline) plus where leveraged positions would be liquidated around the current price: the nearest liquidity magnet above and below, the net pull direction, whale bids and asks within 5 percent, o

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: The live news wire OwlChart reads, newest first: crypto news, market-moving X accounts, stock and macro news, crypto rule changes and chart patterns, each with its source, the time to the second, the link, and for coins the price at the headline and the move since. Also the next economic calendar ev

tools.name: get_open_interest
tools.description: Live open interest for a coin summed across 13 exchanges (Binance, Bybit, OKX, Bitget, Gate, KuCoin, HTX, MEXC, Kraken, Coinbase International, Hyperliquid, dYdX, Aster), one row per venue with coins, dollars and share, plus the 24 hour change.

tools.name: get_orderbook_depth
tools.description: Resting bids and asks for a coin across the wired exchanges: depth near price, the biggest walls and the buy/sell imbalance.

tools.name: get_owl_score
tools.description: OwlChart's 0 to 100 score for a coin: market regime (45 percent) plus entry signal (55 percent), with the verdict, price and RSI. A reading of conditions, not a trade call.

tools.name: get_etf_flows
tools.description: Bitcoin or Ethereum spot ETF flows fund by fund (BlackRock IBIT/ETHA, Fidelity, Grayscale ...), recent days, and OwlChart's "are the institutions selling?" verdict from three raw sources.

tools.name: get_funding_rates
tools.description: Perpetual funding rates for a coin on every exchange OwlChart reads, straight from the exchanges. Positive means longs pay shorts.

tools.name: get_liquidations
tools.description: Long and short positions actually liquidated for a coin over the last hours, recorded by OwlChart from the exchanges' public feeds.

tools.name: scan_patterns
tools.description: Runs OwlChart's pattern engine on a market and timeframe: detected candlestick and chart patterns with their measured historical win rates and a confluence score.

tools.name: get_market_radar
tools.description: A quick read of the major coins at once (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, BNB, DOGE, ADA, WLFI): Owl Score, price and verdict for each.

tools.name: get_tokenization_overview
tools.description: How much real-world value is on-chain today, read from the contracts: stablecoins, tokenised treasuries and funds (BlackRock BUIDL, Ondo ...), tokenised gold and shares, against the size of each world market.

tools.name: get_crypto_regulation
tools.description: The latest on crypto market structure law and regulators (the CLARITY Act and related bills, SEC and CFTC items), with dates, from OwlChart's live regulation tracker.

tools.name: show_chart
tools.description: Shows an interactive OwlChart candle chart inside the chat for any market (crypto, stocks, forex, commodities), with the liquidity magnets above and below drawn on it for crypto coins. Also returns the numbers. Use it when the user wants to see a chart.

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Sets an alert on OwlChart data, checked every minute. Types: price_above = price goes above the threshold (dollars); price_below = price goes below the threshold (dollars); oi_change = open interest summed across 13 exchanges moves by the threshold percent from when the alert was set (negative numbe

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: Lists this member's alerts, active and recently fired.

tools.name: delete_alert
tools.description: Deletes one of this member's alerts by its id (from list_alerts).

tools.name: check_alerts
tools.description: Returns this member's alerts that fired since the last check, and marks them read.

tools.name: get_watchlist
tools.description: This member's own OwlChart watchlist with the live price and 24 hour change of each market.

tools.name: add_to_watchlist
tools.description: Adds one or more markets (tickers like BTC, WLFI, AAPL) to this member's own watchlist, up to 30.

tools.name: remove_from_watchlist
tools.description: Removes markets from this member's own watchlist.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: The public, forward-tested record of OwlChart's liquidity pull model: every call logged before the outcome, then scored. All-in hit rate, direction accuracy on calls where price actually moved, the 95% range and pending calls, overall and per coin.

tools.name: get_money_flows
tools.description: Where money moved over the last day: stablecoins minted and burned (read from the contracts), tokenised gold and treasuries, BTC and ETH spot ETF flows, BlackRock's bitcoin, and the 24 hour open interest change for the major coins.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "create_alert" is 875 chars, far longer than this server's median (167). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Sets an alert on OwlChart data, checked every minute. Types: price_above = price goes above the threshold (dollars); price_below = price goes below the threshol…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_liquidations, create_alert · Private data: get_track_record · Public sink: get_open_interest, create_alert, get_track_record · Destructive: create_alert, delete_alert, remove_from_watchlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_liquidations, create_alert · Private data: get_track_record · Public sink: get_open_interest, create_alert, get_track_record · Destructive: create_alert, delete_alert, remove_from_watchlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
